visual.general_description: Paired line plot of KOOS-JR for 33 patients before injection and at six weeks, with a mean line and error bars.
visual.detailed_description: Line plot with a light axis frame on a white background. The vertical axis is labelled "KOOS-JR (0−100)" with printed ticks 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90 and 100. The horizontal axis has two printed category labels, "Pre-injection" on the left and "6 weeks" on the right, and the label "Patients, n = 33" beneath. Many thin teal lines join a pre-injection point to a 6-week point; three thin red lines slope downward between the two labels and the remaining teal lines mostly slope upward. A thick dark-blue line with large round markers and error bars joins the two group means and rises from the pre-injection label to the 6-week label. A legend in the upper left reads "Mean ± SE". The 6-week end points are spread over a wider range than the pre-injection end points.
